_readme: ADDITIVE rules block for the Accounting app (invoice.html).
The philinity project shares ONE database + ONE rules file across apps
(Eats, Cellar, Taskboard, ...). Add ONLY the 'accounting' block below as a
sibling of the existing app blocks inside rules -> DO NOT drop, overwrite,
or wildcard any other app's block. Verify the other blocks are intact
Access model: any signed-in Google user can read/write /accounting, same
as Cellar's /cellar block. App-level authorization is enforced by the
sign-in gate (roster at taskboard/access + root-admin UIDs); RTDB email
transforms can't reproduce the app's emailToKey sanitization reliably
(rules .replace is first-occurrence-only), so mirror Cellar's approach.
Data shape: /accounting/data/<key> where each key is ONE JSON string
